pt.guion: Bem-vindo ao portal de referencia linguaforge. Dominio: Linguas (motor de pratica). Reune 3 temas construidos a partir de 5 fontes de dados abertos verificadas: lexico comparado, leitura graduada, referencia academica. Tudo gratuito, sem credenciais, e funciona sem ligacao a Internet.

en.guion: Welcome to the linguaforge reference portal. Domain: Languages (practice engine). It brings together 3 topics built from 5 verified open data sources: comparative lexicon, graded reading, academic reference. All free, no credentials, and it works offline.
